name: @polymarket-bot/backtest-cli
description: Backtest CLI (WP-210, BACKTEST-1, BACKTEST-2): verifies a WP-130 dataset against its manifest and replays it deterministically through the simulation package; its run command builds the shared trading core (@polymarket-bot/trading-core, ADR-022) itself and drives it through the replay hook, writing a SIMULATED artifact. BACKTEST root over the PAPER core, simulated venue, no credential, no venue connection, no signer, no order.

scripts.start: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node ./dist/main.mjs
